statement: Suppose that A is separable and satisfies (C). For every positive contraction x ∈ A, every γ > 0, and every integer k ≥ 2, there are c.p.c. maps νn : Mk → A such that ν : Mk −→ Aω ∩ A′ , ν(z) = [(νn(z))n], is order zero, and there is a number κ > 0 for which for every n ∈ N and every irreducible representation σ of A, ∥σ(x)∥ ≥ γ =⇒ ∥σ(xνn(1))∥ ≥ κ. (8.1) One may take κ = γ2/32. In particular, the estimate holds on one ω-large set of coordinates simultaneously for every irreducible representation, including representations chosen separately at each coordinate.
